states.title: Prove the remaining MABK positivity conjecture for all n ≥ 6 (#11561)
Prove Lichtenfelz–Modin–Preston Conjecture 1: four Zeitlin six-j identities
Prove Wu–Zhong–Wu Eq. (37): sharp GHZ product-density bound 1/2
math(quantum): prove support-aware relative entropy data processing for finite channels
Prove Alai’s GHZ–Mermin Staircase conjecture (#13111)
Refute Abdesselam Problem 2: XY padded Ginibre inequalities on a five-cycle
Refute the universal precession GME threshold by singlet padding (#13586)
Prove the Higuchi–Sudbery four-qubit average-entropy maximum (#13454)
math(mayer): the 0-fidelity bound F ≥ 1−(3/2)(1−F₀) is tight for every n, with equality iff every Kraus operator has Pauli weight ≤ 1 (Mayer, arXiv:2109.09629)
Prove Wang's disorder-free localization conjecture on even hypercubes (#14480)
Prove the five three-outcome PI Bell inequalities and settle #15121
Prove the order-three Rényi information-combining equality and record #15115
Refute convexity of quantum Wasserstein channel complexity (#15149)
Refute the Fiol–Martínez-Montoya–Rios Fukelman tree Lee–Yang conjecture (#15357)
Refute the conjectured bound QTD² ≤ QJS₂ (Liu, Computational Complexity 2025, arXiv:2303.01952 §1.3)

math(magic-additivity): at (α, z) = (2, 1) the α-z Rényi relative entropy of magic is strictly subadditive on a three-qubit pair, refuting Rubboli–Takagi–Tomamichel's boundary additivity conjecture (Quantum 8, 1492 (2024), §5)
Prove supported entropy equality iff one fixed completed Petz channel recovers
freeze(math): CHSH nonlocality is tightly bounded by the steering-ellipsoid centre (Milne–Jennings–Jevtic–Rudolph, arXiv:1404.3951, Conjecture 1)
Refute the four-MUB bound-entanglement necessity conjecture in dimension eight
Refute the positive-Kraus side-entanglement conjecture and record #16535
Prove Zhan–Gupta–Hillery detector-sensor Dicke optimality (#16668)
Prove linear repetition-count variance for the noisy voter model (#16646)
freeze(math): the exact critical concurrence for universal teleportation through qubit channels is √(5 − 2√3)/3 (Ghosal–Das–Banerjee, Phys. Rev. A 103, 052422, Conjecture 1)
Prove the de Oliveira–Barbosa–Galvão symmetric GHZ-resource conjecture (#16724)
freeze(math): for two qubits the SVD entanglement entropy is at least the smaller entanglement entropy (Parzygnat–Takayanagi–Taki–Wei, JHEP 12 (2023) 123, Eq. (3.38))
Prove the Yu–Duan–Xu Schur-channel diamond-distance equality (#16745)
freeze(math): the lower boundary of the entropy region of qutrit channels and their complements is the conjectured curve (Czartowski–Braun–Życzkowski, Int. J. Quantum Inf. 17, 1950046, Conjecture 1)
freeze(math): the Geiger–Kedem spin-1 spin-entropy changes by 1/891 between the relative phases 0 and π, refuting Conjecture 1 (Entropy 24, 1292)
math: negativity at most (χ−1)/2 does not imply positive χ-reduction (Abellanet-Vidal–Müller-Rigat–Rico–Sanpera, arXiv:2604.02420, §5.4)
math: the spacetime density matrix violates the Audenaert-type Schatten subadditivity (Milekhin–Adamska–Preskill, arXiv:2502.12240, Conjecture 1)
math: the eigenvalues of symmetric two-qubit entanglement witnesses satisfy µ3 ≥ −√(µ1µ2) (Champagne–Johnston–MacDonald–Pipes, arXiv:2108.10405, §6(c))
math: same-phase periodic SSH ground states can have positive averaged excess pseudo entropy (Kharel–Limbu–Khatri–Khanal–Adhikari, arXiv:2606.29311, §VI)
Refute the Song–Chen–Đoković unique-basis EOF question and record #16853
Refute Saleem et al.'s noisy entanglement-curvature conjecture (#17681)
Settle Hirche–George–Nuradha–Wilde 2026 §9: conditional hockey-stick contraction coefficients reduce to orthogonal states and do not depend on γ (arXiv:2608.27171)
Prove Novaes's strong-absorption cumulant conjecture (#16825)
